grade_note: all hard gates passed (box press 0 / clearance >=16 / anchors smooth / regularity) + 0 line crossings

exactness.method: crossing-number exactness not computed (pass --exact to compute)
exactness.scope: proven_optimal holds only relative to the model class defined in docs/crossing-exact.md sections 1-5: the good-drawing crossing-number caliber (adjacent edges do not cross, each pair at most once, no three edges through one point), the 2-edge-connected core family after safe reduction, and the planar-subgraph x full-embedding family covered by the B&B. No optimality claim is made over the full metric set or an arbitrary drawing space.

honest_notes: Hard-gate caliber: box press = 0 (1px margin), edge-box clearance >= 16px, smooth anchors, simple-graph regularity

Mutual pairs (a<->b bidirectional edges): two-line minimum distance >= 4px (lens double-arc / parallel offset / outer detour; merging back into a double-arrowhead line is forbidden; card-piercing counting deduped per edge x card)
Line-line visual coincidence pairs = 0 (any two lines running in parallel within <1px over >8px count as coincident; momentary meetings at endpoint anchors excluded; machine-checkable metric)
Dual crossing accounting: the routing-theory per-edge hit count sum / 2 must equal the delivered-geometry recheck count; on mismatch the certificate is refused

Routing math: obstacle avoidance = clearance-inflated obstacle visibility graph Dijkstra shortest path (exactly optimal on the graph; vs the true continuous-space shortest path around rounded-corner obstacles, at most (2 - pi/2) x inflation margin px more per hugging corner); smoothing = tangent arcs at bends (G1 tangent-continuous, bounded curvature); convex tangent arcs dip toward the obstacle side by r*(1/cos(theta/2) - 1), bounded by the inflation margin

Spine-wing caliber (v0.7.1): hub pair strictly vertical on the spine axis (x alignment <= 2px gate), wings pressed onto the midline horizontal band (adherence <= 2px gate), outer mirror pairs symmetric top-to-bottom (mirror error <= 2px gate) — cross-checked against the hand-pulled reference sample classic-cld-growth-and-burden; detection = deterministic topological metrics (hub pair with >= 3 common neighbors + pairable rest secondary clusters + main-chain length share <= 0.5), see docs/layout-modes.md; spine edges constructed as vertical straight lines, the rest through the Router; row alignment / column snap reports inapplicable (honestly None)
no_zero_crossing_claim_for_all_graphs: CLDs are often non-planar; the crossing count is an objective-function minimization term, not a theorem guarantee. This certificate holds only for this graph and this layout
